senses.gloss: m. (an adaptation of βωμός, treated in inflection as a cacophemism = <he>בי מיאוס</he>, v.
units: Tosef. Ab. Zar. V, 6, quot. bel., cmp. איצטריא; Syr. בומסא, Ch. בַּמְסָא, בִּימְסָא, בָּמוֹסָא) pedestal of idolatrous statuary.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:7">Ab. Zar. III, 7</cite> a stone originally hewn <he>לב׳</he> for an idol’s pedestal.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:8">Tosef. ib. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:8">VI</cite>), 8 <he>ב׳ שנפגם</he> a broken bomos, (contrad. to <cite ref="M00708"><he>מזבח</he></cite>); Bab.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 53b:12">ib. 53ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ב׳ אבן וכ׳</he> a bomos is made of one stone, an altar of several.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:10">Tosef. ib. VI, 10</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 10:5:2">Y. B. Mets. X, end, 12ᶜ</cite> <he>העלה על גבי ב׳</he>, read <cite ref="D00617"><he>דִּימוֹס</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>בִּימוּסָאוֹת</he>, <cite ref="B00633"><he>בִּימוּסְיָאוֹת</he></cite>, <he>בִּימוֹסִיּוֹת</he>, <he>בִּימְס׳</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:6">Ab. Zar. IV, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 53b:12">53ᵇ</cite>) <he>ב׳ של מלכים</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., Mish. N. <he>בומסיות</he>) pedestals temporarily put up for the reception of princes (governors). Ib. 54ᵃ <he>בימסיאות בשעת השמד</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) idolatrous pedestals (or altars) erected during (the Hadrianic) persecution, <he>אע״פ שהשמד בטל אותן הב׳ לא ביטלו</he> although the persecution has been repealed, they (the Romans) have not cancelled these altars; v. <cite ref="B00515"><he>בָּטֵל</he></cite> Pi.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:11">Gen. R. s. 53</cite>, a. e. (some ed. <cite ref="B00633"><he>בִּימָסוֹת</he></cite>) altars.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:6">Tosef. Ab. Zar. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:6">VI</cite>), 6 <he>בֵּי מוּסְיָיאוֹת</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="B00633"><he>בימסיות</he></cite>). [<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:7">Ab. Zar. I, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16a:13">16ᵃ</cite>) <he>בימוסיאות</he>, <cite ref="B00633"><he>בימסיות</he></cite>, read with Ms. M. a. Ar. <cite ref="D00625"><he>דִּימוֹסְיָאוֹת</he></cite>.]
